title: Sales Forecasting Dashboard
summary: An interactive sales analytics and forecasting dashboard that enables users to explore business performance and predict future sales using time series modeling.
highlights: Developed an interactive dashboard to analyze sales performance including KPIs, category breakdown, regional analysis, and product-level insights.
Implemented time series forecasting using Facebook Prophet to predict future sales trends with confidence intervals.
Designed a dynamic filtering system allowing users to analyze data by year, category, region, and segment.
Built rich data visualizations using Plotly including trend lines, heatmaps, bar charts, and pie charts.
Integrated alert system to detect significant drops in predicted sales and provide business insights.
Created a clean and modern UI using Streamlit with custom styling for better user experience.

title: GadgetSnap
summary: A project to build a machine learning model that predicts suitable smartphones based on consumer-defined specifications.
highlights: A project for the Algorithm of Programming II course, involving 2 members, aimed at applying Machine Learning through a website within a 2-month timeframe.
The objective was to assist users in finding mobile phones based on desired specifications using classification methods.
Managed the backend by utilizing Flask to connect the Machine Learning model with the website and performing web scraping, resulting in a total of 187 data entries.

title: Tokopedia Review Analyzer
summary: An interactive web application to scrape, analyze, and visualize product reviews from Tokopedia using machine learning techniques such as sentiment analysis and topic modeling.
highlights: Developed an end-to-end data analysis pipeline from web scraping to interactive visualization using Streamlit.
Implemented sentiment analysis using IndoBERT (HuggingFace Transformers) to classify user reviews into positive, neutral, and negative sentiments.
Applied topic modeling (LDA) to extract key discussion themes from user reviews across different rating categories.
Built interactive dashboards with filtering, keyword search, and real-time data exploration using Plotly and Streamlit.
Processed and analyzed large-scale user-generated text data, including preprocessing, stopword removal, and feature extraction.

title: Cholesterol Classification Prediction
summary: A machine learning project designed to predict cholesterol levels based on patient health data.
highlights: This project focuses on predicting the classification of an individual's cholesterol based on health indicators to identify which variables influence cholesterol levels.
Performed model interpretation and analysis of the results.
Deployed the model using Streamlit by creating a user-friendly interface to showcase the model's capabilities.

title: Product Sales Performance Dashboard
summary: This dashboard is designed to comprehensively monitor and analyze product sales performance across multiple stores.
highlights: Profit trends remained relatively stable with slight fluctuations from 2020 to 2022.
The Nova brand dominated both sales volume and total profit.
Partner and reseller channels were the main contributors to revenue.
The highest concentration of sales occurred on the island of Java.

title: Indonesia Tourism Trends Dashboard (2022-2025)
summary: An interactive dashboard that analyzes trends in domestic tourist travel in Indonesia from 2022 to 2025, including seasonal patterns, entry point distribution, and geographic insights.
highlights: Developed an interactive dashboard using Google Sheets with dynamic year filtering to explore tourism trends from 2022 to 2025.
Analyzed key performance indicators (KPIs) such as total trips, monthly averages, peak and lowest travel months, and year-over-year growth.
Built time series visualizations to identify seasonal travel patterns and fluctuations throughout the year.
Created distribution charts to compare entry points (air, sea, and land) and identify dominant transportation modes.
Implemented geographic visualizations using Geo Charts to map the distribution of tourist entry points across Indonesia.
Designed ranking and sorting mechanisms to highlight top-performing entry points dynamically.
Applied conditional formatting (heatmaps) to reveal seasonal patterns and peak travel periods.
Ensured a clean and structured dashboard layout for intuitive data exploration and storytelling.

title: Employees Performance Dashboard
summary: The Employees Performance Dashboard is designed to help management comprehensively monitor human resource conditions, including employee performance, attendance rates, and job satisfaction.
highlights: Customer Service, Product, and Operations departments show the highest average performance.
Sales and Marketing departments have relatively lower performance scores compared to other departments.
Positions such as QA Engineer, Operations Manager, and Warehouse Supervisor demonstrate the highest performance.
The scatter plot shows a positive correlation between training hours and performance scores.
Employees classified as High and Excellent performers have more consistent attendance rates.

title: BRI Liga 1 Dashboard
summary: This dashboard presents visualizations of BRI Liga 1 2024/25 player statistics. In this project, player data was independently collected through web scraping from Transfermarkt, then processed, cleaned, and visualized into an interactive dashboard to generate informative insights.
highlights: Several players such as Sonny Stevens, Nadeo Argawinata, and Lúcio recorded the highest playing minutes.
Players originate from various cities, with a strong concentration from Jakarta, Surabaya, and Kediri.
